subject: Renewal: Northbound expansion — SLA addendum & term swap
messages:
From: Eliot Ford <eford@northbound.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: procure@northbound.ai
Date: Fri, 10 May 2029 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal and capacity increase — request for proposal

Diego,

Hope you’re well — our renewal with Redwood is up in July and we want to align the contract to support a larger live footprint for Q4. We’re projecting ~20% steady-state growth in tokens/month and expect several high-sensitivity endpoints to move to low-latency SLAs.

Specifically, procurement asked if you can provide:
- A term option that increases reserved capacity by 20% vs current baseline
- A premium SLA addendum (faster latency SLOs + priority support)
- Any standard uplift discounts for committing to a 12- or 24-month term

Can you share a proposal and a mutual action plan we can circulate internally? Procurement is sensitive to onboarding windows (must be complete before 2029-10-01).

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call next week if that helps.

—Eliot
Eliot Ford
Head of Platform Engineering
Northbound Analytics
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Eliot Ford <eford@northbound.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 13 May 2029 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal and capacity increase — request for proposal

Eliot — thanks for the clear ask. High level response below; attaching a draft MAP and SLA addendum for review.

Quick summary (proposal):
- Term options: 12 months (preferred) or 24 months. 12-month price is our baseline; 24-month gets an additional 5% term discount.
- Capacity: reserved pool + burst — reserved GPUs increased by 20% (matches your request) with 30% burst headroom for seasonal spikes.
- SLA & SLOs (premium addendum): 99.95% availability SLA; latency SLO p95 < 150ms for synchronous text-generation endpoints (measured at edge egress), p99 tail monitoring and regression alerts in Console. Priority P1 response = 1 hour, P2 = 4 hours.
- Onboarding: 4-week ops onboarding window (applies before 2029-10-01); runbooks and a technical onboarding sprint included.
- Commercials: incremental capacity priced at list, with a one-time onboarding credit of $15k if you sign a 12-month commitment by 2029-06-15.

Next steps I suggest: review the attached MAP (Northbound_MAP_v2.xlsx) and SLA draft; Marissa will confirm the exact discounting and procurement language; Ben will scope the onboarding timeline with Prod Infra. If that looks good we’ll prepare a redline-friendly addendum for you to circulate.

I’m free Wed 15 May 10–11am PT if you want a short sync.

Cheers,
Diego Fernandez
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
P: (415) 555-0162
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 May 2029 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: margin check + onboarding capacity for NB-2029-045

Quick internal note — tagging next steps for quoting: 
- Ben: validate the 20% reserved increase and the 30% burst assumption vs current pool. If burst cannot be delivered on their current fleet, we need to call out a phased ramp (weeks 0–8 for burst enablement).
- Pricing: I can absorb the $15k onboarding credit if we keep the 12-month list uplift to <= 12% over current ARR for the incremental capacity. If they push for a deeper discount, escalate to sales leadership.
- Legal: Diego, we should avoid long-tail SLA financial credits in the addendum; propose operational remedies + credits capped to 3 months of incremental capacity spend.

I’ll prep an internal binder and drop comments on the SLA_Addendum_Draft_Northbound.pdf.
—Marissa
Director, Commercial Ops | Redwood Inference
From: Northbound Analytics Procurement <procure@northbound.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Eliot Ford <eford@northbound.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 May 2029 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal and capacity increase — request for proposal

Diego / Marissa,

Thanks for the draft — a few procurement asks and clarifications after an internal review: 
1) Term: Northbound prefers a 24-month term if you can move to an effective 7% discount vs 12-mo pricing and include a CPI-style cap for annual increases.
2) SLA credits: procurement insists on a monetary credit schedule for SLA misses rather than purely operational remedies. Can you provide a short example (table) of credits by incident severity?
3) Data residency / audit: we need confirmation that audit logs for requests and KV caching metadata are retained for 13 months and accessible via the Console for compliance audit.
4) DocuSign routing: Procurement needs the addendum to route to our procurement mailbox (procure@northbound.ai) and to our legal contact (legal@northbound.ai).

Please include any standard security/compliance statements we can attach to our SOW. Timewise we need the signed agreement before 2029-06-30 to meet internal procurement cycles.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Procurement (on behalf of Northbound)
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Northbound Analytics Procurement <procure@northbound.ai>, Eliot Ford <eford@northbound.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 28 May 2029 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal and capacity increase — request for proposal

Team — appreciate the clear asks. Short answers and attachments: I’ve attached a redline of the SLA addendum and an updated MAP (Northbound_MAP_v2.xlsx) that reflects: 
- Commercials: 24-month term with a 7% lookback discount vs 12-mo list if committed by 2029-06-15. CPI cap language included in Section 3.2.
- SLA credits: included an example table in the addendum (monetary credits by severity). Legal flagged a cap equal to 3 months of incremental spend (per Marissa’s guidance).
- Data & audits: confirmed 13-month retention for request/audit logs and Console access for exports; added a security appendix reference to our SOC2 attestation URL.
- Routing: we’ll set DocuSign to target procure@northbound.ai and legal@northbound.ai; link: https://redwood.app/docusign/nb-sla-2029

Attachments: SLA_Addendum_Draft_Northbound.pdf (redline), Northbound_MAP_v2.xlsx (MAP + timeline).

Action items: 
- Eliot / Procurement: confirm the 7% term acceptance and DocuSign recipients by 2029-06-10 so legal can finalize.
- Ben: start scheduling the ops onboarding sprint for the window 2029-09-02 -> 2029-09-30 (tentative) and confirm resource names.
- Marissa: finalize commercial quote and prepare the final order form.

If you’d like, we can do a 30-minute walkthrough of the addendum tomorrow at 11am PT.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
